subject: general
question: The ratio of numbers of girls and boys participating in sports of a school is 1 : 5. If the number of girls is 201, determine the number of boys participating in the sports.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
**Ratio** of **Girls** : **Boys** = 1 : 5.

Given 1 unit = 201 (**Number of girls**).

Number of boys = 5 units = 5 × 201 = 1005.

**∴ The correct answer is 1005.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of **Girls** to **Boys** = 1 : 5

Number of **Girls** = 201

**Formula Used:**

Value of one part = (Given Quantity) ÷ (Corresponding Ratio Part)

Required Quantity = (Value of one part) × (Required Ratio Part)
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ceeb9ca8c529880ee6029b74d41e23d89632a1398a9612d5811400816fbfbf4.png] 
**Calculations:**

⇒ Ratio of **Girls** (G) : **Boys** (B) = 1 : 5

⇒ Let **Girls** = 1x and **Boys** = 5x

⇒ x = 201

⇒ Number of **Boys** = 5x

⇒ Number of **Boys** = 5 × 201

⇒ Number of **Boys** = 1005

**∴ The correct answer is 1005.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio & Proportion

A **ratio** compares two quantities. If a : b = x : y, then a/b = x/y.

Total Participants

To find the **total number of students**, add the units (1 + 5 = 6 units) and multiply by the value of one unit (6 × 201 = 1206).

Unitary Method

This method involves finding the value of a **single unit** first and then multiplying to find the required value.</p
